items.source: Note that as it is expected to be used mostly for accessing factory methods, this factory by default operates in a singleton fashion. The first request to getObject() by the owning bean factory will cause a method invocation, whose return value will be cached for subsequent requests. An internal singleton property may be set to "false", to cause this factory to invoke the target method each time it is asked for an object.
items.translation: 请注意，由于预期主要用于访问工厂方法，该工厂默认以单例模式运行。拥有者 bean 工厂对getObject()的首次请求将触发方法调用，其返回值将被缓存以供后续请求使用。可以设置内部singleton属性为"false"，以导致该工厂在每次被要求获取对象时都调用目标方法。

items.source: NOTE: If your target method does not produce a result to expose, consider MethodInvokingBean instead, which avoids the type determination and lifecycle limitations that this MethodInvokingFactoryBean comes with.
items.translation: 注意：如果您的目标方法不产生需要暴露的结果，请考虑使用MethodInvokingBean，它可以避免此MethodInvokingFactoryBean所带来的类型确定和生命周期限制。

items.source: Set if a singleton should be created, or a new object on each getObject() request otherwise.
items.translation: 设置是否应创建单例，否则在每次 `getObject()` 请求时创建新对象。

items.source: Set if a singleton should be created, or a new object on each getObject() request otherwise. Default is "true".
items.translation: 设置是否应创建单例，否则在每次`getObject()`请求时创建新对象。默认值为"true"。

items.source: Return the type of object that this FactoryBean creates, or null if not known in advance.
items.translation: 返回此 FactoryBean 创建的对象类型，如果无法预先确定则返回 `null`。

items.source:
Returns the same value each time if the singleton property is set
to "true", otherwise returns the value returned from invoking the
specified method on the fly.
items.translation: 如果将单例属性设置为"true"，则每次返回相同的值；否则，动态调用指定方法并返回其返回值。

items.source: afterPropertiesSet in class MethodInvokingBean
items.translation: `afterPropertiesSet` 类中的 `MethodInvokingBean`

items.source: This invoker supports any kind of target method. A static method may be specified by setting the targetMethod property to a String representing the static method name, with targetClass specifying the Class that the static method is defined on. Alternatively, a target instance method may be specified, by setting the targetObject property as the target object, and the targetMethod property as the name of the method to call on that target object. Arguments for the method invocation may be specified by setting the arguments property.
items.translation: 此调用器支持任何类型的目标方法。可以通过将 `targetMethod` 属性设置为表示静态方法名的字符串来指定静态方法，并使用 `targetClass` 指定定义该静态方法的类。或者，可以通过将 `targetObject` 属性设置为目标对象，并将 `targetMethod` 属性设置为要在该目标对象上调用的方法名来指定目标实例方法。可以通过将 `arguments` 属性设置为方法来指定方法调用的参数。

items.source: NOTE: This method returning false does not necessarily indicate that returned objects are independent instances. An implementation of the extended SmartFactoryBean interface may explicitly indicate independent instances through its SmartFactoryBean.isPrototype() method. Plain FactoryBean implementations which do not implement this extended interface are simply assumed to always return independent instances if the isSingleton() implementation returns false.
items.translation: 注意：此方法返回 false 并不一定表示返回的对象是独立实例。实现扩展的SmartFactoryBean接口的实现可以通过其 SmartFactoryBean.isPrototype() 方法明确指示独立实例。未实现此扩展接口的普通 FactoryBean 实现，如果其isSingleton() 实现返回 false，则假定总是返回独立实例。

items.source: NOTE: If a FactoryBean indicates that it holds a singleton object, the object returned from getObject() might get cached by the owning BeanFactory. Hence, do not return true unless the FactoryBean always exposes the same reference.
items.translation: 注意：如果 FactoryBean 表明它持有一个单例对象，那么从 getObject() 返回的对象可能会被其拥有的 BeanFactory 缓存。因此，除非 FactoryBean 始终暴露相同的引用，否则不要返回 true。

items.source: This class depends on afterPropertiesSet() being called once all properties have been set, as per the InitializingBean contract.
items.translation: 该类依赖于在根据 InitializingBean 约定设置完所有属性后调用一次afterPropertiesSet()。

items.source: The default implementation returns true, since a FactoryBean typically manages a singleton instance.
items.translation: 默认实现返回 true，因为 FactoryBean 通常管理一个单例实例。

items.source:
This method allows the bean instance to perform validation of its overall
configuration and final initialization when all bean properties have been set.
items.translation: 此方法允许 Bean 实例在其所有属性设置完成后，执行其整体配置验证和最终初始化。

items.source:
The singleton status of the FactoryBean itself will generally
be provided by the owning BeanFactory; usually, it has to be
defined as singleton there.
items.translation: FactoryBean 本身的单例状态通常由拥有它的 BeanFactory 提供；通常，它必须在那里被定义为单例。

items.source: Invoked by the containing BeanFactory after it has set all bean properties and satisfied BeanFactoryAware, ApplicationContextAware etc.
items.translation: 由包含的BeanFactory在设置所有 bean 属性并满足BeanFactoryAware、ApplicationContextAware等接口后调用。
